hypothesis: General domain vocabulary gaps prevent semantically correct requirements from matching. Adding only evidence-backed synonym and API-domain normalization will recover lexical misses without changing scoring, gates, threshold, or top-k.
acceptance: Increase all-expected reach by at least two queries over R1, with average model calls below 1.5 and false-candidate exposure no more than 14.
interpretation: Vocabulary gaps were causal and recall improved materially with no increase in false-exposure count. The predeclared average-call gate below 1.5 was missed, so R2 is retained only as an input to a separate filtering experiment.
